title: Attio footer
description: A dark full-width footer: the wordmark at the top left, link groups in four columns on the right (two on phones) with grey group titles, small blue 'new' pills and ↗ marks for outside links, then social icons and a quiet copyright and legal row along the bottom.
notes: forces the dark palette and marks itself data-header-tone="dark" for the attio header
groups choose their desktop and phone column (column / phoneColumn); otherwise they fill columns in turn
name: attio-footer

props.name: brand
props.description: the brand's name: the home link's label for screen readers

props.name: groups
props.type: (AttioFooterGroup & { column?: number | undefined; phoneColumn?: number | undefined; })[]
props.description:
link groups, poured into four columns on desktop and two on phones; give `column`
on each to choose its desktop column (0–3)

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: small icon links at the bottom left (lucide icons work well)
